//doc: Connecting a local package (packages/enum-concern) like path-repository.
symlink: true — edits to packages/ are visible immediately, without composer update.
After adding repositories: composer require emreyarligan/enum-concern:^1.0
IMPORTANT: in composer.json of the package itself must be committed 'version'
(for example "version": "1.0.7"), otherwise constraint ^1.0 will not resolve.
B Docker symlink must point inward build-context.
